# Reedy Creek Seventh-day Adventist Church

> A small, close-knit Seventh-day Adventist church at 9 Bridgman Drive, Reedy Creek QLD 4227, on the Gold Coast, Australia. Everyone is welcome.

Every Saturday: Prayer Meeting 9:10am, Sabbath School 9:30am, Church Service 10:45am, followed by a shared fellowship lunch.

## Pages

- [Home](https://arquerkii.github.io/reedy-creek-church/): Service times, latest sermon, and an overview of church life
- [Plan Your Visit](https://arquerkii.github.io/reedy-creek-church/visit.html): What to expect on your first visit, parking, children and families, FAQ
- [About Us](https://arquerkii.github.io/reedy-creek-church/about.html): Our story and community
- [What We Believe](https://arquerkii.github.io/reedy-creek-church/beliefs.html): Our beliefs in plain language
- [Giving](https://arquerkii.github.io/reedy-creek-church/about/give.html): How tithe and offerings are used, and how to give
- [Sermons](https://arquerkii.github.io/reedy-creek-church/sermons.html): Latest messages from our YouTube channel
- [Ministries](https://arquerkii.github.io/reedy-creek-church/ministries/): Overview of all our ministries
- [Kids & Families](https://arquerkii.github.io/reedy-creek-church/ministries/kids-families.html): Adventurers, Pathfinders and children's Sabbath School
- [Young Adults](https://arquerkii.github.io/reedy-creek-church/ministries/young-adults.html): Camps, hikes, run club and Bible study for ages 16+
- [Community Outreach](https://arquerkii.github.io/reedy-creek-church/ministries/community-outreach.html): The LifeBoat food van, The Movement and community services
- [Health & Wellness](https://arquerkii.github.io/reedy-creek-church/ministries/health-wellness.html): Wellness courses with ELIA Wellness
- [Worship & Fellowship](https://arquerkii.github.io/reedy-creek-church/ministries/worship-fellowship.html): Music, media, prayer, men's ministry and social events
- [Sabbath School](https://arquerkii.github.io/reedy-creek-church/ministries/sabbath-school.html): Saturday Bible study for adults, young adults and children
- [Contact](https://arquerkii.github.io/reedy-creek-church/contact.html): Contact form and how to reach the pastor
